# Vendored Ante core

Source: https://github.com/rizkyandriawan/ante, commit b46da09.
`ante-core/src` and `ante-core/tests` are copied unchanged; Cargo metadata is
standalone. License: MIT (see ../LICENSE). Keep core updates explicit and run its
Rust tests plus the Python integration suite after updating.

`ante-amqp/src` and `ante-amqp/tests` are also copied unchanged from the same
revision, with standalone Cargo metadata. Both crates use the MIT license.
